entry.title: New: dsh-stylevault
entry.summary: 30 classic open-source theme palettes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Solarized, etc.) mapped to official ThemeService tokens for DeepSeek Harness, with a Style Settings panel for live color/font/radius tweaks and JSON export/import for sharing config packs. Exact install spec: github:gptsapp/dsh-stylevault. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
